subject: sub-12
notes: Manual ICA decisions after reviewing topographies and properties.

0.label: posterior_visual_component
0.notes: Broad posterior negativity with smooth gradient from occipital to parietal — dipolar with weak anterior positivity. Spectrum shows a prominent alpha peak (~10 Hz) and beta harmonic strongly supporting neural origin. Stable, continuous time course across all 3000+ segments. Keep.

1.label: eye_blink_artifact
1.notes: Strong frontal positivity maximal at Fp1/Fp2 with posterior negativity extending beyond scalp — classic EOG/eye blink topography. Extremely high variance outliers (up to 7000 AU). Reject.

2.label: global_noise_component
2.notes: Broadly positive red field covering entire scalp with a central blue ring — ring-like topography inconsistent with any dipolar neural source, likely a reference or common-mode artifact. Extreme variance outliers. Reject.

3.label: global_noise_component
3.notes: Nearly uniform red field with multiple irregular sign-change islands — not dipolar. Several separate hotspots visible (central, inferior posterior, bilateral temporal). Extreme variance outliers. Reject.

4.label: global_noise_component
4.notes: Broadly positive red field with a central blue ring — same ring artifact pattern as IC002. Not dipolar. Despite some alpha-like spectral activity, the topography is not consistent with a neural source. Extreme variance outliers. Reject.

5.label: edge_artifact
5.notes: Focal negativity at right fronto-central region with a separate small inferior positive island — fragmented, not dipolar. Topography is non-smooth and inconsistent. Extreme variance outliers (up to 1000 AU). Reject.

6.label: posterior_visual_component
6.notes: Right posterior focal positivity with left anterior negativity — smooth and dipolar, consistent with a lateral occipital/visual source. Spectrum shows a prominent alpha (~10 Hz) and beta peak confirming neural origin. Very stable time course across all segments. Keep.

7.label: global_noise_component
7.notes: Nearly uniform dark red field with a single central focal hotspot and bilateral temporal sign-change islands — not dipolar. Segment image shows organized activity only in early segments suggesting a recording artifact. Reject.

8.label: posterior_visual_component
